title: Diploma In Business Management (Level 5)
description: A comprehensive programme designed to equip learners with core competencies in business strategy, marketing, law, and management practices.
longDescription: This diploma offers an in-depth understanding of the functional areas of business management. It prepares learners to address real-world challenges with strategic thinking and practical decision-making. The course integrates theoretical knowledge with applied learning to support career readiness. Emphasis is placed on leadership, marketing, human resource management, legal understanding, and business finance. Learners will gain the tools necessary to succeed in various organizational contexts. Time Table The programme runs from 26 October 2026 to 26 July 2027, covering six academic learning and assessment periods. Teaching includes guided lectures, practical activities, case studies, group discussions, independent study and assignment preparation. A Winter Vacation is scheduled from 21 December 2026 to 8 January 2027, followed by a Spring Vacation from 29 March to 16 April 2027. The final period focuses on assignment completion, assessment, quality assurance, academic review and confirmation of programme completion, with results processed in August 2027.
courseDetails: The programme covers six key modules focused on strategic planning, legal frameworks, human resources, marketing, accounting, and entrepreneurship. Through case studies and applied projects, learners will explore the decision-making processes that drive business performance. It is suitable for individuals aiming for supervisory or managerial roles across industries. Assessment includes assignments, practical tasks, and real-world business applications.

entry: For entry into Level 5 Diploma in Business Management, learners must possess the following:
* Relevant/Local Board of Examination Result in your Country, which must include at least 5 'C' Grades in English and 4 other subjects.
* Mock Examination Result can also be accepted for initial Conditional Admission, pending the release of the Board of Examination Result. (This is assessed on a case by case basis)
* Learner must be 18 years or older at the start of the Course.
* Mature Learners (21 years or older) with work experience in supervisory, leadership or management roles. (This is assessed on a case by case basis).
accreditation: All GSS courses are accredited by the relevant partners and awarding bodies. Please refer to GSS accreditation in about us for more details.
workshops: Workshops are conducted by live webinars for online students. Classroom workshops are available if there is a local branch in your country. Speak our course advisors on this subject.
visa: There is no Visa requirement for this programme.
gettingStartedIntro: Complete the application, document review, offer, payment and enrolment steps through the learner portal.

modules.title: Level 5 - Principles And Concepts Of Strategy
modules.summary: This module focuses on strategic thinking and planning frameworks that guide business growth and sustainability. Learners explore competitive positioning, environmental analysis, and strategic implementation. Emphasis is placed on aligning business objectives with market conditions. Practical tools like SWOT, PESTLE, and Porter’s Five Forces are applied to real scenarios.

modules.title: Level 5 - The Management Of Human Resources
modules.summary: This module provides insight into human resource functions including staffing, employee development, labor relations, and legal compliance. Learners examine how HR practices influence organizational performance. Topics include workforce planning, employee engagement, and HR strategy alignment. The module prepares learners to manage teams effectively within diverse workplaces.

lessons.title: The Evolution of Human Resource Management

modules.title: Level 5 - Marketing For Managers
modules.summary: Students gain a thorough understanding of marketing concepts from a managerial perspective. The module covers customer behavior, segmentation, targeting, positioning, and marketing mix strategies. It enables learners to develop effective marketing plans based on analysis and research. Case studies help bridge theory with practice in dynamic market environments.

modules.title: Level 5 - Business Law For Managers
modules.summary: This module introduces essential legal knowledge required by managers in the business environment. Key areas include contract law, employment law, consumer protection, and corporate obligations. Learners develop the ability to identify legal risks and ensure regulatory compliance. The content is designed to support ethical and lawful decision-making in business contexts.

lessons.title: Introduction to Business Law for Managers

modules.title: Level 5 - Management Accounting And Decision Making
modules.summary: This module explores the use of financial information in planning, control, and strategic decision-making. Learners study budgeting, costing, variance analysis, and financial performance evaluation. The content supports sound managerial judgement through accurate financial interpretation. Practical scenarios help students apply techniques to improve operational efficiency.

lessons.title: Chapter one - Management Accounting and Decision Making
Chapter 2 - Management Accounting and Decision Making

modules.title: Level 5 - Business Start-up: Conception To Market
modules.summary: Focusing on entrepreneurship, this module guides learners through identifying, developing, and launching a business idea. It covers feasibility analysis, business planning, funding strategies, and marketing approaches. Learners are encouraged to turn creative ideas into commercially viable products or services. The module fosters innovation, resilience, and market awareness.

outcomes: Analyse and apply strategic models to support long-term business planning and competitive advantage.
Evaluate human resource management techniques in relation to recruitment, motivation, and performance development.
Demonstrate understanding of core marketing principles and how they guide managerial decisions.
Interpret and apply business law concepts relevant to managerial roles and organizational compliance.
Utilize management accounting tools for planning, control, and decision-making purposes.
Develop and assess a viable business idea from concept to market readiness using entrepreneurial frameworks.
